remarks:
Welcome to one of Chautauqua Lake's most extraordinary waterfront properties, where panoramic lake views surround you from nearly every room and create a setting that is rarely found. Perfectly positioned on the shoreline, this exceptional Bemus Point residence offers an unmatched connection to the water, with breathtaking vistas stretching in every direction and a spectacular lakefront lawn that invites endless days spent enjoying the beauty of the lake.

Designed for effortless living and unforgettable entertaining, the outdoor spaces are truly exceptional. Gather on the expansive lakeside patio, complete with a custom outdoor kitchen featuring a built-in grill and stone oven, all overlooking the sparkling waters of Chautauqua Lake.

Inside, the thoughtfully designed three-level home offers generous living spaces filled with natural light and stunning lake views. The main level features a spacious living and dining room with an additional lakeside sitting room and a lakeside sitting room, a breakfast room just off the kitchen, and a welcoming family room. An impressive indoor grill room, complete with an open-hearth gas grill, wet bar and full bath, seamlessly connects the home to the lakeside patio, making indoor-outdoor entertaining effortless.

Upstairs, the primary suite showcases breathtaking panoramic lake views that greet you each morning. A second private bedroom suite features its own lakeside glass-enclosed sitting room—an incredible space to relax with a morning coffee, unwind with a book, or enjoy spectacular sunsets and star-filled evenings over the water. Two additional bedrooms and another full bath complete the second level. The third floor offers an additional bedroom and full bath, providing comfortable accommodations for guests.

This is more than a lakefront home—it's a legacy property offering one of the most remarkable waterfront settings on Chautauqua Lake. Whether hosting large gatherings, enjoying peaceful mornings by the water, or creating lifelong memories, this exceptional residence offers a lifestyle that is as rare as its panoramic views.
